description:
🔴 **`packages/react-native/` has no `package.json`.** It holds three TypeScript files — the TurboModule `Spec`, the types, and the control surface — and nothing that can build, typecheck or publish them. Same class of gap as the two native targets: not broken code, *no project*.

The TurboModule spec is deliberately narrow and that constraint must survive: **no `uploadChunk`, no `readFile`, no transfer loop.** JS does not run while the app is suspended, so a JS-driven transfer fails the backgrounding requirement by construction — which is exactly why the existing React Native uploaders cannot meet it. Commands in, coalesced events out.

A guard is worth more than a comment here: this is the constraint most likely to be eroded by a later well-meaning convenience method.

userStories.title: The package builds and typechecks
userStories.description: A package manifest, a TS config, and whatever codegen configuration the TurboModule requires.
acceptanceCriteria: `npm install && npm run build` (or equivalent) succeeds from `packages/react-native/`.
React Native codegen configuration is declared so the native spec can be generated.
The peer-dependency range on `react-native` is stated and justified — TurboModules are not available in every version.
userStories.notes: npm install && npm run build: green; npm run typecheck with strict mode: green. Declared codegenConfig for AmphoraSpec and peer dependency react-native >=0.76.0, justified in README as the minimum TurboModule codegen surface used here.

userStories.title: A guard keeps transfer logic out of JavaScript
userStories.description: The narrowness of this surface IS the design. Make its erosion a build failure rather than a code-review question.
acceptanceCriteria: A check fails if the TurboModule spec grows a method that reads file bytes or drives a transfer loop.
The check names the reason in its failure message, referencing `docs/reference/platform-constraints.md` §3.
It runs in CI and in `.chief/verify.sh`.
userStories.notes: npm run check:control-surface: green; mutation test with uploadChunk failed with the documented §3 reason; .chief/verify.sh and GitHub Actions CI both run the guard.
